false_statement: One fixed-row theorem may choose a sufficiently large row after a hypothetical zero is introduced.
counterexample_or_no_go: Quantifier order: the detector must be fixed before the zero; the proof establishes only existence of a row depending on the zero.
what_survives: Holomorphic-defect transfer and each fixed-row transform.

false_statement: Positive floor-kernel Möbius convolution detects reciprocal-zeta poles.
counterexample_or_no_go: Finite Möbius inversion gives a positive coefficient sum and the floor zeta factor cancels 1/zeta.

false_statement: Controlling only the positive Hardy or divisor-GCD excess controls the unknown scalar.
counterexample_or_no_go: Both squares equal |sum c_n|^2 plus a positive excess; the unknown root remains.
what_survives: Positive divisor-restriction renewal and exact decompositions.

false_statement: Universal two-node Pick positivity bootstraps abstractly to order three.
counterexample_or_no_go: Exact planted off-line orbit has a negative rational three-node determinant.

false_statement: Strict concavity, low scalar shadows, or adjacent log-convexity imply all-order passivity.
counterexample_or_no_go: Rational squared-pole model passes low shadows but has a negative higher Loewner determinant.
what_survives: Order-two Loewner and adjacent low-order Hankel results.
current_replacement: All Hankel orders or a positive Krein-string realization.

false_statement: An arbitrarily large fixed number of positive Loewner/Hankel orders rules out an off-line pole pair.
counterexample_or_no_go: N real poles plus one weak conjugate pair pass through order N+1 and fail later.
what_survives: Every prescribed fixed order is eventually positive high on the safe axis.

false_statement: One safe Green specialization implies full Pick continuation.
counterexample_or_no_go: A planted bounded-type factor preserves the safe specialization while violating the target Pick kernel.
what_survives: Safe-real Pick criterion and local/global continuation conditional on actual local positivity.
notes: Positive safe-side data are not sufficient.

false_statement: The scalar fixed-scale carrier derivatives form the full weighted mean-zero form core.

false_statement: Unitary amplitude scattering signs the radial curvature.

notes: Amplitude and curvature are different levels.

false_statement: A scalar Wigner-Smith commutator represents the full cross-carrier delayed Gram.

false_statement: Raw positive delays preserve the model space.

current_replacement: Compressed delay semigroup and leakage cocycle.
notes: All leakage cross terms must be retained.

false_statement: The completed Xi Fisher law is the positive ordinary-prime Poisson law.
counterexample_or_no_go: The completed law is quasi-infinitely divisible but not infinitely divisible in the cited safe range.
what_survives: Separate prime Poisson and completed Fisher colligations.
notes: Canonical source lock needs exact parameter conversion.

false_statement: The raw normalized Fisher-Hankel multiplier has a dense natural Hardy L2 core.
counterexample_or_no_go: Two-sided exponential decay plus Paley-Wiener support forces every such boundary function to vanish.
current_replacement: Bounded feature plus explicit unbounded ambient leg.

false_statement: One fixed Hilbert contraction maps all completed Fisher scales to all Suzuki scales.
counterexample_or_no_go: Speed obstruction and cross-Gram rigidity contradict the scale curves.

false_statement: Weyl centering preserves parity and leaves logarithmic heat unchanged.
counterexample_or_no_go: W(f)^*Pi W(f)=W(-2f)Pi and Weyl conjugation shifts dGamma(log q).

false_statement: A phase-blind common fractional heat Gram has tunable exponential rate O(theta).
counterexample_or_no_go: The all-minus Bohr twist has localized energy exponential type exactly 1/2.
what_survives: Sibuya source, exact difference-kernel Gram, fixed-center frontier.

false_statement: The unphased Tao port diagonal automatically pays logarithmic phase rotation.
counterexample_or_no_go: At P={3}, x=3, tau=pi/log 3 the 2x2 determinant is -80/81.
current_replacement: Phase-dependent diagonal or a cross-scale covariance theorem.

false_statement: A positive spectral/pole completion creates the signed cancellation needed for tunable heat.
counterexample_or_no_go: Its positive diagonal retains an exponential rate independent of theta.
notes: Positive completion cannot substitute for signed cancellation.

false_statement: Absolute phase-blind prime bounds cross the constant-four log-log frontier.
counterexample_or_no_go: The phase-blind adverse ratio grows for q=(4+epsilon)loglog|x|.
notes: Method firewall, not a counterexample to desired sign.

false_statement: PSD completion, fixed-window large sieve, finite moments, or source-blind square functions prove the Q4 sign.
counterexample_or_no_go: Each operation loses the signed source correlation or leaves the RH-equivalent reciprocal-zeta-square resonance.
current_replacement: Balanced coprime Type-II / nonlocal compact-current estimate.

counterexample_or_no_go: Selected-prime Steinhaus/polygon/Kronecker vertical limits force zeros.
current_replacement: A height-dependent producer or direct infinite canonical system.
notes: Heavy scans not needed for analytic no-go.

counterexample_or_no_go: The reviewed positive-mixture/vertical-limit theorem covers the declared current weights.

current_replacement: Prove the fully corrected low block is nonnegative before elimination.

what_survives: Corrected hyperbolic index, Darboux and rank-one completions.

counterexample_or_no_go: Every fixed degree is eventually positive from the growing positive leading operator whether or not RH holds.
